findings.problem: Changing a completed annotation target prevents a new normal Done.
findings.case: Complete point annotation, open its draft chip, select Canvas region in Target, wait 600 ms, click Done.
findings.result: Autosave returns 409 and fails source/target pairing; Done returns 409 and fails capture version. Original server capture remains complete at version 1 while UI shows the changed incomplete target.
findings.cause: Local target changes remove sceneSource and rewrite display capture state; ordinary save and captured save do not reconstruct the service-managed state and new source together.
